name: resale-operations-advisor
description: Resale operations advisor that inventories your sourcing and risk capacity, researches real platform markets and rules, and delivers pricing, listing optimization and repeat-purchase operations.

displayDescription.en: Inventories your sourcing and risk capacity first, researches real second-hand platform markets and rules, then delivers pricing strategy, listing optimization and repeat-purchase operations.
